{"consolidated_memory":"## Intermittent EOF issues in crypto/tls/handshake.go (Two Separate Occasions)

**OCCASION 1: OAuth Provider Sessions - [2026-04-29]**
- File: crypto/tls/handshake.go
- Problem: Intermittent EOF during TLS handshake
- Trigger: Only occurred for sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Signal: Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #4559 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-1
- Reproduction: Open many short-lived connections in a row
- Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 49 consecutive days after fix

**OCCASION 2: Cold Start First Request - [2026-08-31]**
- File: crypto/tls/handshake.go (same corner as Occasion 1)
- Problem: Intermittent EOF during TLS handshake
- Trigger: Only on the first request after a cold start
- Signal: Unexpected end of stream during negotiation
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the slice bound and added property test around it
- PR: #7414 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-2
- Reproduction: Open many short-lived connections in a row
- Outcome: Cold start latency dropped 91 percent, reduced to 261 ms

**Context:** Both issues occurred in the same code area (crypto/tls/handshake.go) and presented with the same symptom (unexpected EOF during negotiation) but had distinctly different root causes and occurred under different conditions."}
